t: Look up. This is The Shard, ninety-five storeys of pyramid-shaped glass in Southwark, standing 309.6 metres high. It is the tallest building in the United Kingdom and in Western Europe. It replaced Southwark Towers, a 24-storey office block built on the site in 1975. The Italian architect Renzo Piano designed it, and it is the centrepiece of the Shard Quarter. Piano also designed the Pompidou Centre in Paris and won the Pritzker Architecture Prize in 1998.
